season.evidence: Searched: range lists spring-fall; north-facing snow lingers into July. Stored Jul-Sep; logged Skookum-area ascents Jul-Sep.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sep 5 long traverse of both Twins, Jaws Tooth and Skookum from the Weyerhaeuser bridge, bailing down South Twin; not this route
Aug 20 round trip from the Green Creek trailhead (6.8 km from our pin), no report

facts.text: In early September the glacier above Green Creek basin was icy and broken, a poor way down; the long west ridge of South Twin was a straightforward class 3 retreat.
Jaws Tooth has fun layback moves; moving through the fifth-class ground past it on two simul-climbing rope teams took parties hours.

notes: The packet lists only one route; the stored Jaws Tooth and Northwest Ridge route is not in routes[]. Tracks start from different trailheads than our FR 38 Elbow Lake pin and none is route-specific.
